name: Volley Clash
subtitle: Two touches, one winner
description: Arcade beach volleyball with dashes, charged spikes and power-ups. Play solo against the AI, share a keyboard with a friend, or go online at 1v1 or 2v2 on a wider court.
controls: P1: A/D move, W jump, Shift dash  |  P2: arrows move/jump, / dash  |  Touch: drag the left half to move, tap the right half to jump
